_note: Ceramic IF filter, 10.7 MHz (three leads: in, gnd, out). Engine (bw-board ceramic_filter): two piezo resonators coupled through a shunt capacitance, a two-pole Butterworth band-pass designed for hz (10.7 MHz), bandwidthHz (280 kHz) and ohms (330 Ohm terminations), resonator q (1500); in the RF bands only, open at audio and DC.
